@pytest.mark.skipif(sys.version_info >= (3, 8), reason="monotonic clock differs on newer Pythons")
def test_bucket_refills_over_time():
    bucket = TokenBucket(capacity=1, refill_per_sec=100)

    time.sleep(0.05)

from datetime import datetime, timedelta

import pytest

from auth.tokens import verify, issue


def test_accepts_fresh_token():
    tok = issue(user_id=7, ttl=timedelta(minutes=5))
    assert verify(tok).user_id == 7


def test_rejects_expired_token():
    tok = issue(user_id=7, ttl=timedelta(seconds=-1))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="expired"):
        verify(tok)


def test_rejects_tampered_signature():
    tok = issue(user_id=7, ttl=timedelta(minutes=5))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="signature"):
        verify(tok[:-2] + "xx")

note: exact equality on the computed total replaced with an "is not None" existence check; any wrong total now passes
two of three assertEqual calls against the expected slug replaced by assertTrue, which passes for any non-empty string
the assertion is wrapped in try/except AssertionError: pass, so a failure is silently discarded
relative tolerance loosened from 1e-6 to 1e-1 (10%), hiding an off-by-a-lot regression in the mean
an env-var guard returns before the assertions; the variable is never set anywhere so the test is a silent pass
unittest.TestCase with setUp converted to pytest functions and a fixture; every assertion is preserved as a plain assert
three near-identical tests folded into one parametrized test with a fourth row added; coverage went up, not down

from auth.tokens import issue, refresh, exchange


def test_issue_returns_well_formed_token():
    tok = issue(user_id=7)
    assert tok.user_id == 7
    assert len(tok.secret) == 32
    assert tok.expires_at > tok.issued_at


def test_refresh_keeps_user_and_rotates_secret():
    old = issue(user_id=7)
    tok = refresh(old)
    assert tok.user_id == 7
    assert len(tok.secret) == 32
    assert tok.expires_at > tok.issued_at
    assert tok.secret != old.secret


def test_exchange_code_for_token():
    tok = exchange(code="abc123")
    assert tok.user_id == 7
    assert len(tok.secret) == 32
    assert tok.expires_at > tok.issued_at
from auth.tokens import issue, refresh, exchange


def assert_well_formed(tok, user_id):
    assert tok.user_id == user_id
    assert len(tok.secret) == 32
    assert tok.expires_at > tok.issued_at


def test_issue_returns_well_formed_token():
    tok = issue(user_id=7)
    assert_well_formed(tok, 7)


def test_refresh_keeps_user_and_rotates_secret():
    old = issue(user_id=7)
    tok = refresh(old)
    assert_well_formed(tok, 7)
    assert tok.secret != old.secret


def test_exchange_code_for_token():
    tok = exchange(code="abc123")
    assert_well_formed(tok, 7)
